title: Gamechanger
body:
I cannot stress enough how amazing this app is. I found it through TikTok and I swear, this thing is magical. I deep cleaned my bathroom, and didn‘t feel overwhelmed at all like I usually would. It‘s absolutely perfect when you want to do something, but your mind is all over the place and you don‘t know where to start. 

I also just found the chef function and I am obsessed. I often come home from work to a full fridge but no plan what to cook. So this is a gamechanger for real.

I overall feel like this app is going to help me a lot with daily tasks. 

12/10 would recommend 😙👌🏻
author: melielimarti
